name: ArchiveWriteEntry
comment: Writes or replaces one entry in an Image Line archive (seg 33 = archive unit)

name: ArchiveCompressEntry
comment: Compressed path of ArchiveWriteEntry: u32 unpacked size + LZW stream

name: LzwReadCode
comment: Nested in LzwDecompress: code = (u32 at bitpos>>3 >> (bitpos&7)) & mask; bitpos += width

name: LzwRefillInput
comment: Nested in LzwDecompress: slides the 8 KB input window

name: LzwDecompress
comment: GIF-style LZW 9..12 bit LSB-first; 0x100 clear 0x101 end (tools/lzw.py)

name: LzwResetDictionary
comment: Encoder: width 9; hash table of 5003 (0x138b) entries

name: LzwCompress
comment: Encoder; open-addressing hash with quadratic probe

name: VideoPresent
comment: Frame limiter (TimerCount) + optional VGA retrace wait + WinGBitBlt/WinGStretchBlt of the 320x200 frame; mode >=2 goes to DispDib fullscreen

name: VgaInRetrace
comment: in al 0x3DA bit 3; privileged on NT

name: CdPlayTrack
comment: Builds an MCI 'play cdaudio from N to N+1' string

name: MixerOpenVolume
comment: mixer* API: finds a CD/wave volume control

name: SoundLoadWav
comment: DWS_WAV2DWD: converts a WAV to DiamondWare's format in memory

name: SoundPlay
comment: DWS_DPlay of sample #param; loads it on first use

name: KeyPoll
comment: GetKeyState(vk) -> per-key counter at DAT_1170_9c28[vk]: >0 held for N polls

name: MainWindowIdle
comment: OWL idle hook: while the window is active and has capture: GameFrame() then VideoPresent(). This is the main loop.

name: GameFrame
comment: One game tick: update (or demo playback when DAT_1170_0f28==1)

name: ReadGameInput
comment: Fills gInput[0..8] from the key map gKeyMap (numpad as fallback); 1-0/PgUp/PgDn select weapons; mouse via GetCursorPos; demo playback replaces all of it

name: HeroUpdate
comment: The hero: reads gInput and moves/animates Leon (1591 lines)

name: GameFrameInGame
comment: Update everything then draw when gDrawThisFrame; also the zoom-in viewport (gZoom > 0x40)

name: gKeyMap
comment: 9 VKs: Up Down Left Right LeftShoot RightShoot (x2) SwitchWeapon; defaults arrows/Insert/Space/Tab

name: gInputUp
comment: gInput[0]: KeyPoll counter (>0 held for N frames)

name: gZoom
comment: >0x40 zooms the viewport in around the hero

name: gKeyCounters
comment: Per-VK hold counters maintained by KeyPoll

name: HeroMoveAndCollide
column5: y) against tile solidity bit 2 (walls) and moving platforms (gPlatforms); floors and slopes via HeroFindFloor

name: HeroFindFloor
comment: Floor/slope search under the feet; returns new y or 0x7fff (no floor); slope tiles have solidity bit 0x20

name: HeroPushOutOfWalls
comment: Nudges x by 1 px out of a wall overlap

name: HeroAccelerate
comment: gHeroVX += accel, clamped to |limit|  (args: limit, accel)

name: HeroStartJump
comment: State <- kind (>0 = airborne kind), gHeroVY <- vy (1/10 px/frame; -50 = jump), resets fall distance unless already falling

name: HeroTouchTiles
comment: Tile functions at body height: 10000 = end level; 7030 = sensitive lever

name: TileSolidityAt
comment: (y,x) px -> TILE INFOS +8 of the cell in plane gTilePlane; 0xa75f outside the map

name: TileFunctionAt
comment: (y,x) px -> TILE INFOS +6 (function 0, e.g. 10 ladder, 60600 pipe, 60800 hang pipe)

name: TileParamOfLastCell
comment: (n, cell) -> TILE INFOS function n of the cell TileXxxAt just looked up

name: SpriteQueue
comment: Queue a sprite for drawing: (layer, facing, y, x, frame, slot)

name: SoundPlayAt
comment: (sound id, y, x): positional sound effect

name: gHeroState
comment: 0 ground; >0 airborne (1 jump, 5 wall jump, 6/7 flips, 0x10 hit); -1 hang pipe; -2 climb up; -3 ?; -4 ledge; -5 ladder; -30 action; -40 crouch; -80 face camera; -100 door; -200 knocked down; 100 dead

name: gHeroVX
comment: horizontal speed; moved by |vx|/4+1 px per frame when walking

name: gHeroCrouch
comment: crouch progress 0..8; also generic state timer

name: gHeroVY
comment: 1/10 px per frame; gravity +10 (+3 while Up is held)

name: gHeroPlatform
comment: moving platform stood on (index | 0x80 if facing right)

name: gHeroGround
comment: ground contact kind this frame (0 none

name: gCheatFly
comment: ETFLY: >0 free 8 px movement through walls

name: gInputReleased
comment: gInputReleased[0..8]: action was released since it last fired (no auto-repeat jumps)

name: gHeroLadderKind
comment: -1 none; TILE INFOS function 2 of the ladder tile (0 rope

name: DemoRecordFrame
comment: Extends the key/mouse runs; every 35th frame stores RandSeed into CHECK

name: DemoLoad
comment: Reads entries 0..10 (not CHECK); RandSeed := 0; version must be 3

name: DemoPlayFrame
comment: Replaces ReadGameInput polling with recorded gInput and mouse; stops at frame 0

name: LevelInit
comment: Randomize unless a demo is playing or recording; then spawns the level
